confirmed: Same prescribed lowlr/aligned runs improved both standard metrics from step600 to2000, while schedule regressed.
All final G exceed B in PR-AUC; schedule Fmax is effectively equal B, lowlr/aligned gains small.
Aligned at step2000 is below lowlr; 100% first-hop alignment has not demonstrated improved performance.

not_established: No significance or paired standard-metric bootstrap available.
No v085 graph ablations or retrained graph-off baseline provided.
No evidence G exceeds E/M; gaps remain about14 Fmax and16 PR-AUC points.
No causal claim that whole-graph coverage explains earlier regressions.
No independent development contract; selecting preset or checkpoint from ind_test is not permitted.
recommended_constraints: Let running dynamic complete precommitted budget; compare to aligned because configs share native_dropout=1 and lowlr.
Encoder-only controlled comparison first: preserve decoder, losses, sampler, evidence masking, binary pseudo labels, fixed scheduler horizon, and no E/M probability path.
Do not change architecture, loss, fanout, label injection and native dropout in one experiment.
Use honest withheld development data for model selection; core holdout already seen by Stage1 is monitor only.
Do not automatically extend all old runs; if a completion experiment is justified, prospectively pair fixed budgets and avoid test-driven winner continuation.
Record per-role difficult-gold losses, non-candidate positives, support/PU conflicts, and stream-specific evidence effects before assuming width/depth is the main bottleneck.
